verdict.rationale: Angular's official CLI documents a first-party command that runs unit tests in a project (angular-docs-11), and community members describe Angular as having comprehensive built-in test support and being obsessed with testability (angular-comm-15, angular-comm-7). Nothing in the pack shows utilities that actually render a component in isolation or let you interact with it. missing for 10: documented component-rendering test harness or fixture APIs, evidence of simulating user interaction with isolated components, in-depth testing docs, hands-on corroboration of component-level testing.
